content:
This module existing not duplicate fix update now FINAL IVX ADMIN-CONTROLLED DEAL SYNC
APP + LANDING + REELS + POSTS + INVESTMENT PATHWAYS

EXECUTE END TO END NOW.

OBJECTIVE

Create one canonical, owner-controlled deal management system.

The IVX Admin Dashboard must control every project displayed across:

- IVX mobile application
- IVX web application
- public landing page
- member home
- investor home
- buyer home
- JV Deal module
- tokenized investment module
- Post cards
- Reels cards
- deal-detail pages
- owner dashboard
- investor portfolio
- buyer pipeline
- autonomous reports

Do not maintain separate hardcoded project data for the landing page,
mobile app, Reels, Post cards, or dashboards.

Required architecture:

ADMIN DASHBOARD
→ CANONICAL DEAL RECORD
→ API
→ CACHE INVALIDATION
→ APP
→ LANDING PAGE
→ POST CARD
→ REELS CARD
→ DEAL DETAILS
→ TRANSACTION WORKFLOWS
→ REPORTING

==================================================
1. CANONICAL DEAL DATA MODEL
==================================================

Create or verify one canonical deal record for every IVX project.

Required fields:

deal_id
slug
title
subtitle
description
project_type
status
visibility
city
state
country
public_address
private_address
developer_id
sponsor_id
issuer_id
property_owner_id
sale_price
approved_valuation_basis
capital_target
capital_raised
capital_remaining
currency
target_roi
roi_disclaimer
timeline_status
current_stage
progress_percentage
estimated_completion
display_order
featured
published
created_at
updated_at
published_at
version

Required media relationships:

deal_images
deal_videos
deal_reels
deal_documents
deal_updates

Required pathway configuration:

tokenized_enabled
jv_enabled
buyer_enabled

No interface may use a project title as the canonical identifier.

Use deal_id everywhere.

==================================================
2. ADMIN MASTER CONTROL
==================================================

Create or complete one owner-only Admin Deal Editor.

Admin must be able to control:

- project title
- project description
- location
- sale price
- capital target
- capital raised
- target ROI
- timeline
- stage
- progress
- estimated completion
- developer
- sponsor
- issuer
- media
- image order
- Reel order
- document visibility
- display order
- active/paused/closed/funded status
- landing-page visibility
- app visibility
- Post-card visibility
- Reels visibility
- tokenized pathway
- JV pathway
- buyer pathway
- minimum amounts
- maximum amounts
- available allocation
- approved offering pathway
- disclosures
- agreements
- fees
- contact-routing rules

Every change must produce:

ADMIN USER ID
DEAL ID
FIELD CHANGED
BEFORE VALUE
AFTER VALUE
TIMESTAMP
TRACE ID
VERSION
PUBLISH STATUS

==================================================
3. DRAFT AND PUBLISH WORKFLOW
==================================================

Do not immediately publish every Admin edit.

Required states:

DRAFT
UNDER_REVIEW
APPROVED
PUBLISHED
PAUSED
CLOSED
ARCHIVED

Required workflow:

EDIT
→ SAVE DRAFT
→ PREVIEW APP
→ PREVIEW LANDING
→ PREVIEW REELS
→ PREVIEW POST
→ VALIDATE
→ OWNER APPROVAL
→ PUBLISH
→ CACHE INVALIDATION
→ LIVE VERIFICATION

Admin must be able to preview the exact card before publishing.

==================================================
4. CROSS-PLATFORM SYNCHRONIZATION
==================================================

The same canonical record must power:

- landing investment card
- mobile investment card
- web investment card
- Post card
- Reels overlay
- deal-detail page
- owner dashboard
- investor dashboard
- buyer dashboard
- JV dashboard

When Admin changes one deal:

1. Save canonical record.
2. Create new version.
3. Publish approved version.
4. Invalidate API cache.
5. Invalidate CDN cache where needed.
6. Refresh mobile query cache.
7. Refresh landing-page cache.
8. Update Post cards.
9. Update Reels cards.
10. Record synchronization result.

Required sync report:

DEAL ID:
VERSION:
DATABASE:
API:
LANDING:
MOBILE:
WEB:
POST:
REELS:
OWNER DASHBOARD:
INVESTOR DASHBOARD:
CACHE INVALIDATED:
FINAL STATUS:

==================================================
5. TOKENIZED PATHWAY
==================================================

Each project may independently enable or disable Tokenized participation.

Admin configuration:

tokenized_enabled
tokenized_status
share_price
total_shares
available_shares
reserved_shares
sold_shares
minimum_shares
maximum_shares_per_investor
minimum_investment
maximum_investment
tokenized_capital_target
tokenized_capital_raised
tokenized_capital_remaining
offering_pathway
investor_eligibility
jurisdiction_rules
kyc_required
aml_required
accreditation_required
wallet_required
custody_provider
transfer_agent
tokenization_provider
subscription_agreement
risk_disclosure
offering_documents
launch_date
close_date

Default business rule:

SHARE PRICE:
$50.00 per share

MINIMUM PURCHASE:
1 share

MINIMUM TOKENIZED INVESTMENT:
$50.00

The maximum must be calculated as the lowest permitted value among:

- project tokenized capital remaining
- shares available
- investor-specific maximum
- offering-specific maximum
- compliance limit
- owner-approved allocation

Do not use the phrase “unlimited investment” in the system.

Use:

NO OWNER-DEFINED PER-INVESTOR MAXIMUM

while still enforcing:

- available allocation
- offering rules
- investor eligibility
- compliance limits
- transaction limits

==================================================
6. TOKENIZED ICON ACTION
==================================================

When the user clicks the Tokenized icon:

IF DISABLED:
Show:
“Tokenized participation is not available for this project.”

IF COMING SOON:
Show:
“Tokenized participation is coming soon.”
Allow:
- Join waitlist
- Request notification
- Learn more

IF ACTIVE:
Open the Tokenized Deal page.

Required Tokenized page:

- project
- share price
- shares available
- minimum shares
- maximum permitted shares
- investment amount
- ownership/economic-interest explanation
- capital target
- capital raised
- remaining allocation
- target ROI
- timeline
- project risks
- offering documents
- eligibility requirements
- KYC status
- accreditation status where applicable
- jurisdiction restrictions
- fees
- agreement
- payment
- receipt
- portfolio position

Required amount selector:

NUMBER OF SHARES × SHARE PRICE = INVESTMENT AMOUNT

Example:

1 share × $50 = $50
10 shares × $50 = $500
100 shares × $50 = $5,000

The server must recalculate all values.

Never trust the client-submitted total.

==================================================
7. TOKENIZED STATUS LABELS
==================================================

Use only:

TOKENIZED_NOT_AVAILABLE
TOKENIZED_COMING_SOON
TOKENIZED_WAITLIST
TOKENIZED_OPEN
TOKENIZED_PAUSED
TOKENIZED_FULLY_ALLOCATED
TOKENIZED_CLOSED

The card badge must reflect the real status.

Do not show an active gold Tokenized badge when the pathway is unavailable.

==================================================
8. TOKENIZED LEDGER
==================================================

When technically and legally active, maintain:

tokenized_offerings
tokenized_share_classes
tokenized_subscriptions
tokenized_allocations
tokenized_ownership
tokenized_transactions
tokenized_distributions
tokenized_documents
tokenized_audit_events

Required allocation states:

REQUESTED
ELIGIBILITY_PENDING
KYC_PENDING
DOCUMENTS_PENDING
PAYMENT_PENDING
PAYMENT_PROCESSING
APPROVED
ALLOCATED
REJECTED
CANCELLED
REFUNDED

Do not issue ownership from a client-side success message.

Ownership must only be finalized after:

- eligibility approval
- agreement completion
- verified payment
- server-side allocation
- ledger entry
- receipt

==================================================
9. JV DEAL PATHWAY
==================================================

Each project may independently enable or disable JV participation.

Admin configuration:

jv_enabled
jv_status
jv_minimum_contribution
jv_maximum_contribution
jv_capital_target
jv_capital_raised
jv_capital_remaining
accepted_contribution_types
jv_structure
preferred_terms
required_experience
required_documents
review_required
owner_approval_required
jv_agreement
jv_disclosures
jv_open_date
jv_close_date

Default business rule:

MINIMUM JV CONTRIBUTION:
$20,000

Owner-defined maximum:

OPTIONAL

But the accepted contribution must never exceed:

- capital remaining
- approved JV allocation
- project need
- owner-approved amount

Display:

Minimum JV contribution: $20,000
Maximum: Subject to project availability and owner approval

Do not display “No limit” to the public.

==================================================
10. JV ICON ACTION
==================================================

When the user clicks JV Deal:

IF DISABLED:
Show:
“JV participation is not available for this project.”

IF ACTIVE:
Open the JV Opportunity page.

Required fields:

- contribution amount
- contribution type
- cash
- land
- construction
- development
- entitlement
- engineering
- architecture
- brokerage
- marketing
- operations
- proposed structure
- requested ownership
- experience
- company
- financial capacity
- message
- documents

Required flow:

AUTH
→ PROFILE
→ JV APPLICATION
→ DOCUMENTS
→ INITIAL QUALIFICATION
→ OWNER REVIEW
→ DUE DILIGENCE
→ TERMS
→ AGREEMENT
→ FUNDING
→ JV RECORD

A JV application is not an accepted investment.

==================================================
11. JV AMOUNT VALIDATION
==================================================

Required server rules:

minimum amount >= $20,000

maximum accepted amount <= project JV allocation remaining

Admin may configure a higher minimum per project.

Examples:

Casa Rosario:
Minimum: $20,000

Perez Residence:
Minimum: configurable

Jacksonville:
Minimum: configurable

The project-specific value overrides the default.

==================================================
12. BUYER PATHWAY
==================================================

Each project may independently enable or disable buyer offers.

Admin configuration:

buyer_enabled
buyer_status
asking_price
minimum_offer
maximum_offer
allow_below_asking
allow_above_asking
earnest_money_required
proof_of_funds_required
financing_allowed
cash_only
inspection_period
closing_target
offer_expiration
buyer_disclosures
broker_commission
buyer_contact_route

Default behavior:

ASKING PRICE:
Use the sale price configured by Admin for that deal.

The Buyer pathway must display:

- asking price
- property information
- buying terms
- financing conditions
- proof-of-funds requirement
- earnest-money requirement
- inspection terms
- proposed closing date
- offer expiration

==================================================
13. BUYER ICON ACTION
==================================================

When the user clicks Buyer:

Open the Buyer Offer page.

Required form:

buyer_name
buyer_company
buyer_type
email
phone
offer_amount
cash_or_finance
down_payment
financing_status
proof_of_funds
earnest_money
inspection_period
requested_closing_date
contingencies
broker
message
offer_expiration

Default offer amount:

PREPOPULATE WITH CURRENT ASKING PRICE

Admin may configure:

ALLOW BELOW ASKING:
YES / NO

ALLOW ABOVE ASKING:
YES / NO

If below asking is not allowed, reject any amount below the current sale price.

If below asking is allowed, label it:

BELOW-ASKING OFFER

If equal:

FULL-PRICE OFFER

If above:

ABOVE-ASKING OFFER

==================================================
14. BUYER OFFER WORKFLOW
==================================================

Required states:

DRAFT
SUBMITTED
IDENTITY_PENDING
PROOF_OF_FUNDS_PENDING
FINANCING_PENDING
UNDER_REVIEW
COUNTERED
ACCEPTED
REJECTED
WITHDRAWN
EXPIRED
UNDER_CONTRACT
CLOSED

Required flow:

AUTH
→ BUYER PROFILE
→ OFFER
→ DOCUMENTS
→ SERVER VALIDATION
→ OWNER NOTIFICATION
→ OWNER REVIEW
→ COUNTER / ACCEPT / REJECT
→ AGREEMENT
→ DEPOSIT
→ CLOSING PROCESS

Do not mark an accepted offer as a completed sale.

==================================================
15. CARD BUTTON BEHAVIOR
==================================================

Every investment card must display only applicable pathways.

Example:

Tokenized enabled:
Show Tokenized badge.

JV enabled:
Show JV Deal badge.

Buyer enabled:
Show Buyer badge.

Do not automatically display all three badges.

Badge behavior:

- active pathway: highlighted and clickable
- coming soon: muted and clickable to waitlist
- unavailable: hidden or disabled
- paused: disabled with explanation
- closed: show closed status

==================================================
16. PRIMARY CARD ACTION
==================================================

Replace the generic Invest Now behavior with contextual routing.

If one pathway is enabled:

Display that action directly.

Examples:

BUY TOKENIZED SHARES
APPLY FOR JV
MAKE AN OFFER

If multiple pathways are enabled:

Display:

PARTICIPATE NOW

Then open a selection sheet:

1. Tokenized — From $50 per share
2. JV Partnership — From $20,000
3. Buyer Offer — From asking price

The selection sheet must use real project settings.

==================================================
17. ADMIN PATHWAY CONTROLS
==================================================

For each project, Admin must be able to:

TOKENIZED:
[ ] Enable
[ ] Disable
[ ] Coming Soon
[ ] Set share price
[ ] Set total shares
[ ] Set available shares
[ ] Set minimum shares
[ ] Set investor maximum
[ ] Set opening/closing date
[ ] Upload documents
[ ] Set eligibility
[ ] Publish

JV:
[ ] Enable
[ ] Disable
[ ] Set minimum
[ ] Set optional maximum
[ ] Set available allocation
[ ] Set accepted contribution types
[ ] Set documents
[ ] Set review requirements
[ ] Publish

BUYER:
[ ] Enable
[ ] Disable
[ ] Set asking price
[ ] Allow offers below asking
[ ] Set minimum accepted offer
[ ] Require proof of funds
[ ] Require earnest money
[ ] Allow financing
[ ] Publish

==================================================
18. ADMIN APP + LANDING PREVIEW
==================================================

Admin must see four live previews before publishing:

MOBILE APP CARD
LANDING PAGE CARD
POST CARD
REELS CARD

Preview must show:

- images
- price
- ROI
- timeline
- pathway badges
- minimum amounts
- buttons
- details
- disclosures
- closed/paused states

==================================================
19. CACHE AND REAL-TIME SYNC
==================================================

After publishing:

- update canonical database
- increment deal version
- invalidate API cache
- invalidate landing CDN cache
- invalidate React Query cache
- publish realtime event
- refresh visible cards
- update Reels overlay
- update Post card
- update Admin preview
- record every result

Target:

Admin publish to live app/landing:
under 60 seconds

Return exact measured synchronization latency.

==================================================
20. DATA CONSISTENCY RULES
==================================================

The following values must always match:

ADMIN
DATABASE
API
LANDING
APP
POST
REELS
DEAL DETAILS

Required values:

- title
- sale price
- share price
- JV minimum
- buyer asking price
- tokenized status
- JV status
- buyer status
- target ROI
- capital target
- capital raised
- remaining allocation
- timeline
- progress
- developer
- media
- display order

Create an automated parity test.

==================================================
21. SECURITY AND SERVER VALIDATION
==================================================

All financial and availability values must be loaded and validated server-side.

Do not trust client values for:

- share price
- number of shares available
- investment amount
- JV minimum
- JV allocation
- asking price
- buyer minimum offer
- capital remaining
- ownership
- fees
- eligibility

Test manipulation of every value.

==================================================
22. PAYMENT READINESS
==================================================

The interface may be built before live payments, but statuses must be truthful.

Use:

PAYMENT_NOT_CONFIGURED
TEST_PAYMENT_AVAILABLE
LIVE_PAYMENT_AVAILABLE

Until a payment provider is configured:

Tokenized:
Allow waitlist/application only.

JV:
Allow application and owner review only.

Buyer:
Allow offer submission only.

Do not simulate completed investments.

==================================================
23. LEGAL AND OFFERING GATE
==================================================

For each project store:

offering_status
offering_pathway
general_solicitation_allowed
accredited_only
non_accredited_allowed
intermediary_required
investor_limits
jurisdiction_rules
approved_disclosures
approved_documents
legal_approval_date
legal_approved_by

Do not allow Tokenized purchase until the project has an approved offering configuration.

Possible public states:

LEARN_MORE
JOIN_WAITLIST
REQUEST_ACCESS
APPLY
INVEST

Only display INVEST when legally and technically approved.

==================================================
24. NOTIFICATIONS
==================================================

Notify the owner for:

- Tokenized waitlist
- Tokenized subscription request
- JV application
- JV document upload
- Buyer offer
- Buyer proof of funds
- Buyer counteroffer response
- eligibility failure
- transaction failure
- allocation nearing full
- project fully allocated

Notify the user for:

- submission received
- additional information required
- approved
- rejected
- countered
- payment available
- payment confirmed
- receipt available

==================================================
25. REPORTING
==================================================

Admin dashboard must show by deal:

TOKENIZED:
- page views
- icon clicks
- waitlist
- applications
- approved investors
- shares requested
- shares allocated
- capital requested
- capital received

JV:
- icon clicks
- applications
- qualified
- under review
- approved
- contribution proposed
- contribution committed

BUYER:
- icon clicks
- offers
- below asking
- full price
- above asking
- proof of funds
- counters
- accepted
- under contract

==================================================
26. REQUIRED DATABASE TABLES
==================================================

Verify or create:

ivx_deals
deal_versions
deal_pathways
deal_media
deal_documents
deal_publish_events
deal_sync_events

tokenized_offerings
tokenized_share_classes
tokenized_waitlist

tokenized_ownership

buyer_offer_events

notifications
audit_events
owner_approvals

Use migrations, constraints, indexes, RLS, and audit fields.

==================================================
27. TEST MATRIX
==================================================

Test every project state:

==================================================
28. DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

After completion:

1. Commit to owner GitHub repository.
2. Return full commit SHA.
3. Deploy backend.
4. Return Render deployment ID.
5. Verify `/health`.
6. Verify runtime SHA.
7. Deploy landing page.
8. Invalidate CloudFront.
9. Rebuild APK if mobile components changed.
10. Return EAS build ID.
11. Install on physical Android.
12. Verify live app and landing synchronization.

==================================================
29. LIVE VERIFICATION
==================================================

Use one real project and perform:

1. Admin changes sale price.
2. Admin sets Tokenized share price to $50.
3. Admin enables Tokenized Coming Soon.
4. Admin sets JV minimum to $20,000.
5. Admin enables Buyer pathway.
6. Admin publishes.
7. Landing updates.
8. Mobile app updates.
9. Post card updates.
10. Reels card updates.
11. Tokenized icon opens correct page.
12. JV icon opens correct application.
13. Buyer icon opens correct offer page.
14. Buyer offer defaults to listed price.
15. Admin receives submissions.
16. Dashboards update.
17. App restart preserves current values.
